notes.title: DEMO 0.32 Update
notes.content:
Here is StoryCropStudio! During this period, besides the usual bug fixes and experience optimizations, we have also made some adjustments to the cards for the female protagonist. Additionally, the highlights of this update include the new "Shop Owner" and the brand-new Imperial Soldier designs.

[list] [*] New shop owner added [*] Changes to Imperial army designs [*] Card/skill adjustments [*] Bug fixes [*] Experience optimization [/list]

[h1]New Shop Owner Added[/h1]

Players can now meet a new character, "Rinne," in the preparation area. Although there is currently no difference in functionality compared to the robot Xiaobi, additional features will be added in the future. Players can now see the new shop owner's appearance in the game and chat with her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/d962611127fff0dd1ed2351cac7dbb3881576420.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/2760a522fa81e9af477a4f420a21a25ddb1bb91c.png[/img]

[h1]Changes to Imperial Army Designs[/h1]

To make the Imperial Army more in line with the story setting, we have revamped the appearance of the first batch of enemies completed in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/9875111e2d55a0cffb5517decb8974c7e4054192.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/c9fd407d7effc1cc284905bb940fcbfdc3a43932.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/354f5ad8aa678814da095a8a46d80fdbb7cde490.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/2ceaab1473119acd456d296d6f9dd0f0b8cb76dd.gif[/img]

[h1]Card/Skill Adjustments[/h1]

[h3]Grayza's default deck: [b]Shattered Impact[/b] replaced with [b]Lead Dice[/b] [/h3]

[h3]All cards requiring a friendly unit must have at least one friendly unit on the field to play.[/h3]

[h3]Invisible Sword Intent[/h3] Consumes all combos. Draws one card and gains Strength (1) for each combo consumed. ↓ Consumes all combos. Draws one card and gains 1 Energy for each combo consumed. Removed after use.

[h3]Bottled Blood[/h3] Gains 1 Energy next turn. Wounded Enhancement (3): Gains 1 Energy. Gains 1 Energy next turn. ↓ Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain 2 Energy. Wounded Enhancement (4): Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain 3 Energy.

[hr][/hr]

[h1]About the Playtest[/h1]

Currently, clicking the Playtest button on the store page might result in an inability to participate in the test. We plan to create a test version for release once the DEMO version's performance is stable. If you clicked the button, we will invite you to the official test when it's ready. If you wish to experience the game now, you can download our demo version and provide feedback through the survey in the game announcement, Discord, or QQ group.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

[h3]Feast[/h3] Randomly discards one card. Gains Strength (1). Wounded Enhancement (3): Randomly discards one card. Gains Strength (3). ↓ Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Draw two cards. Wounded Enhancement (4): Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Draw three cards.

[h3]Power Extraction[/h3] Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain 2 Energy. Wounded Enhancement (5): Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain 2 Energy. Draw two cards. ↓ Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain Strength (2). Wounded Enhancement (3): Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain Strength (3).

[h3]Survival Instincts[/h3] Creates a random "Survival Card." The next time you play the created card, it costs 0 Energy. Wounded Enhancement (5): Creates two random "Survival Cards." The next time you play the created cards, they cost 0 Energy. ↓ Lose 9 HP and draw three cards. Wounded Enhancement (4): Lose 9 HP, draw three cards, and gain 1 Energy.

[h3]Wanton Slaughter[/h3] Deals Bleed (3) to a random target three times. Wounded Enhancement (4): Deals Bleed (3) to a random target five times. ↓ Deals Bleed (7) to a random target four times. Wounded Enhancement (4): Deals Bleed (7) to a random target four times. All enemy units lose HP equal to their "Bleed" stack.

[h3]Tear[/h3] Choose a target: Bleed (3). Wounded Enhancement (4): Choose a target: Bleed (5). ↓ Choose a target: Bleed (10). Wounded Enhancement (6): Bleed (10). The Bleed stack of that unit is doubled.

[h3]Crimson Blade[/h3] Lose 7 HP. Gain Bleeding Blade (1). Wounded Enhancement (3): Gain Bleeding Blade (1). ↓ Lose 4 HP. Gain Bleeding Blade (1). Wounded Enhancement (5): Lose 4 HP. Gain Bleeding Blade (3).

[h3]Rising Killing Intent[/h3] Wounded Enhancement (6): Draw one card each time you use a Wounded Enhancement card. Removed after use. ↓ Wounded Enhancement (4): Draw one card and lose 1 HP each time you use a Wounded Enhancement card. Removed after use.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1] [list] [*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Ancient Flamethrower[/b] blessing would not correctly kill enemies with Burn. [*] Fixed an issue where the cards [b]Insight: Ice Heart[/b] and [b]Insight: Backflow[/b] would trigger multiple times if the enemy had multiple attacks. [*] Fixed an issue where the battle rewards Essence of Artistry and Essence of Ego were incorrectly awarded. [*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze the next turn after using Immortality. [*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze after playing the card Crimson Sword: Dancing Crescent. [*] Fixed an issue where the Discard Two, Draw Two card would skip the discard phase and directly draw cards if only one card was left in hand. [*] Fixed an issue where players could unlock a new difficulty even after losing. [*] Fixed an issue where the page would not refresh after purchasing a blessing. [*] Fixed an issue where the Trial "Rebellion" was added at the wrong time. [*] Fixed an issue where players could re-purchase Legendary Blessings after exiting and re-entering the preparation area. [*] Fixed an issue where Legendary Blessings could be purchased even without enough Dust of Origins. [*] Fixed an issue where the male protagonist's awakening skill would not trigger if he had zero cards. [*] Fixed an issue with incorrect time statistics. [*] Fixed an issue where the second-stage animation and defeat animation of the Iron Can were missing. [*] Fixed an issue where [b]Ymir's Avatar: Assimilation[/b] would consume Wounded even if it couldn't be played due to unmet conditions. [*] Fixed an issue where enemy Bleed numbers would display incorrectly when in Invincible state. [*] Fixed an issue where HP would not recover (e.g., through regeneration) while in Invincible state. [*] Fixed an issue where a character would die at the end of a turn if the Bleed value could kill them, even while in Invincible state. [/list]

[h1]Experience Optimization[/h1] [list] [*] Replaced the general store NPC in the preparation area. [*] Optimized the exit button on the shop page. [*] Increased the scroll speed for character information and the encyclopedia. [*] Swapped the visual effects of the male protagonist's first and second stages of Awakening Cunning, with the second stage now drawing four cards. [*] Reduced the maximum number of concurrent long side quests to two. [*] Certain Debuffs are now set to be unremovable (e.g., Ambush). [*] Updated the illustration for the heroine's character selection page. [/list]

notes.title: DEMO3.0 Released
notes.content:
With everyone's support, we finally managed to launch the brand new demo version after a nearly one-week delay.

We have opened an independent DEMO store page and look forward to your trial. We also welcome you to leave valuable feedback and suggestions in your reviews!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2382030/_Demo/

In this version, we've made a lot of changes and updates. Let's take a look at what's new and changed this time:

[list]
[*] Redesign of character portraits
[*] New illustrator added
[*] New tutorial
[*] Interface overhaul (dialogue/controls/save)
[*] Character changes
[*] Story adjustments
[*] Updated world map objects
[*] New content - Training Grounds
[*] New content - Blessings
[*] New content - Difficulty and Trials
[*] New content - Enemies
[*] New content - Chapter 2
[*] Other adjustments
[*] Future updates
[/list]

[h2]1. Redesign of Character Portraits[/h2]

We've redesigned many character portraits and added more expressions to enhance the overall presentation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/3b31f319980c5ecfc685b18f84dcb65312b19e76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4c615ff360b03b533ad47d72d674c37b5eb902f1.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. New Illustrator Added[/h2]

Many card illustrations in this update are created by the artist 浄藍. The cover art this time is also drawn by 浄藍, and more beautifully styled artworks will be drawn by them in the future. Please look forward to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4fd4f64edb665ae6c280874d2a651d4ddaee6db0.png[/img]

follow 浄藍 on PIXIV
https://www.pixiv.net/users/32869577

[h2]3. New Tutorial[/h2]

One of the key adjustments we've focused on during this period is the new tutorial.

Now, when players start a new save for the first time, they will enter a special map that can only be accessed once. On this map, the gentle character Jel will personally guide new players through the basic rules of "Song of the Weaver."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/e54adff1bd8f825467c02c6645e8b4b032edb14b.png[/img]

At the end of the tutorial, a small surprise awaits the players.

[h2]4. Interface Overhaul (Dialogue/Controls/Save)[/h2]

We have redesigned many interfaces to provide a more comfortable visual experience for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/c3007538bfd6372759a4e71127fcc9a5b905f45f.png[/img]

[u]Settings Interface[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/50d7bd9735e2d063af7cff26f554377503ecd889.png[/img]

Besides the above-mentioned content, there are many more changes waiting for players to experience firsthand.

[h2]5. Story Adjustments[/h2]

We made some modifications to the main storyline to improve the player experience between battles and cutscenes.

Additionally, there are now differences in some cutscenes depending on whether the player chooses a male or female protagonist. Players interested in the story mode content are encouraged to explore this further.

[h2]6. Updated World Map Objects[/h2]

The various event icons and interface on the world map have been revamped to further enhance the quality of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/c1fdfc3f4b9af0bb62f44e7574268b97da455b9f.png[/img]

[h2]7. New Content - Training Grounds[/h2]

Now players can train with the Legion Commander, Sophia, or exchange legendary blessings with her in the preparation area after defeating a boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/a35cf1556a16c5dac66b88fdb2116925a5a94a70.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/b9f54ca48bb8c8fe22bbce2c11acb42eba19f889.png[/img]

[h2]8. New Content - Blessings[/h2]

In this update, we've added over 50 new blessings that players can obtain in missions or the shop, allowing them to create more unexpected combinations during the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4f2a040f916b66689da9c0bd2f33d2213eaef379.png[/img]

[h2]9. New Content - Difficulty and Trials[/h2]

Now players can choose the difficulty level that suits them best when starting the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/e0d6c2df71709d674d44fd6889a9a9b042b843b6.png[/img]

In lower difficulties, the enemy's skills and AI are simplified, allowing players less familiar with the gameplay to experience "Song of the Weaver" more easily.

Additionally, players can challenge the advanced difficulty in the Trial Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/f98f2c13342ad93060317ff09b9c24df918b1728.png[/img]

[h2]10. New Content - Chapter 2[/h2]

In Chapter 2, not only do more dangerous and powerful enemies await the players, but also more adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/e3ffee978d8e516e301d8a262b8b0904d99d8a8b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/33b306a42215d94fcfa59fa6441828daa636e629.png[/img]

At the end of the chapter, two powerful bosses will be waiting for players to challenge them!

[h2]11. Other Adjustments[/h2]

[b]Male Protagonist Deception Pre-Built Adjustment[/b]

We've made significant changes to the Male Protagonist's Deception Pre-Built. The main reason is that its initial strength was too high.

We do not oppose players building a flawless deck, but having an overly strong deck from the start, making all subsequent content irrelevant, is a situation we want to avoid.

[b]Male Protagonist Cunning Awakening Adjustment[/b]

[u]Cunning First Stage Awakening[/u]

Choose 2 cards to discard, draw 4 cards

→Choose 2 cards to discard, draw 3 cards

[u]Cunning Second Stage Awakening[/u]

Randomly generate a 1, 2, and 3-energy card, add them to your hand, and change their cost to 0 (permanently 0 cost)

→Draw 3 cards

[u]Cunning Third Stage Awakening[/u]

Increase hand limit by 2, discard all cards in hand, draw until the hand is full

→Randomly generate a 1, 2, and 3-energy card, add them to your hand, and change their cost to 0 (permanently 0 cost)

After considering various opinions and feedback, we unanimously agreed that the original second stage was far superior to the third stage. In fact, the original second stage of Cunning was already far stronger than the third stage skills of other awakenings.

Therefore, we retained the original second stage skill and replaced the rarely used third stage with it. The first and second stages were changed to better align with the Male Protagonist's discard-based playstyle and to be a stronger version of "Pot of Greed" (draw three cards).

We will continue to observe the status of the third stage of Cunning and consider whether to add some limitations to adjust its strength without changing its effect.

[b]Male Protagonist Card Adjustments[/b]

[u]Discard[/u]

Choose a card to discard, gain Armor (16), Front Row: "Gain Armor (16)"

→Cannot be played, discard from hand: gain 2 energy

[u]Preparation[/u]

Basic Attack (6), draw 1 card

→Draw 3 additional cards at the start of the next turn (repeatable for more turns)

[u]Overnight[/u]

Weaken self (1), draw 2 cards

→Choose 2 cards to discard, then draw 2 cards

[u]Layout[/u]

Permanent Passive: Draw a card every 2 eliminations (repeating this increases the number of cards drawn).

→ Permanent Passive: Draw a card each time you discard a card from your hand (repeating this increases the number of cards drawn).

This adjustment mainly targets the overly stable card-drawing effect of "All-Nighter" (almost equivalent to the Pot of Greed in Yu-Gi-Oh!, which is now a banned card in that game), as well as making adjustments to the other three tricky cards that are too difficult to use.

We do not intend to adjust strong cards like "Double Flip" or "Lucky." On the contrary, we highly encourage players to build their ideal unbeatable deck. Our main focus will be on enhancing underused or difficult-to-use cards.

[b]After Defeat[/b]

Now, after defeat, there will be a chance for regret, I mean, a chance to try again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/c1662854bac1efacf762a867ba1c0d351f834dad.png[/img]

Players can now continuously attempt challenges until they choose to give up!

[b]Tips[/b]

Now, when using tips in the shop, the specified card type rate is 100%.

[b]Resting Place[/b]

Health recovery in the resting place now restores 50%~30% of maximum health, depending on the difficulty.

[b]Text Corrections[/b]

Corrections have been made to errors in the skills, cards, tutorials, and UI text.

[h1]12. Future Updates[/h1]

[u]*The updates mentioned here refer mainly to updates and adjustments for the current version. Content for the official version will not be discussed here.[/u]

[b]Male and Female Protagonist Card Updates[/b]

In the upcoming period, we will focus on adjusting many of the underused/difficult-to-use cards for both male and female protagonists, making them better suited to the current and future game pace and difficulty.

The combat cards for the male protagonist will be a key focus of adjustment, with plans to significantly integrate the types and compositions of these cards, so they no longer feel disjointed as they do now.

[b]Combat Animation Overhaul[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/0683ac47feb51286da609ff3938ec3224fe43929.png[/img]

We will completely revamp the appearance of the Imperial Army in the first chapter of the story to better match the background setting.

There are many more changes and updates in this update that cannot all be listed here. If you have any suggestions (or bugs) for "Song of the Weaver," feel free to let us know.

notes.content:
Happy Valentine's Day everyone, no matter if you have or are still looking for your Valentine's Day partner, Voice of Belldona will bring you new content to spend with you today!

In this update, the most important content is the official decks that you have been waiting for! Although it's only a partial version, we're going to give you a peek at the full version of it! And if you prefer, you can switch between the demo and the updated decks in the encyclopedia! Let's take a closer look at this release!

notes.title: VoiceOfBelldona 0.35.1 Update
notes.content:
With the upcoming New Year's Eve, Voice of Belldona is introducing this update before the New Year. In this update, not only new interactive scenes have been added, but also the battle UI and card styling have been fully revamped.

In addition to the new scenes and new features, there are also a lot of bug fixes and player experience optimization, and brand-new story illustrations, so let's see what else is coming in this update.

[list]
[*] New interactive scenes
[*] New "Recon" feature
[*] New illustrations in the story mode
[*] New card artwork

notes.title: Voice of Belldona 0.32.2 Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.
Today we're going to talk about what we've done to update Voice of Belldona in the meantime!
In this update, we've made the following fixes and optimizations:

-Combat Scene Adjustment
-Beginner's tutorial now has a new NPC (you can guess who she is in the story mode).
-Adjusted Griza's Ally Summoning.
-Revamped the Source Nexus
-Campsite revamped
-New Encyclopedia
-Story Mode adjustments/new characters
-Modified the position of the card information display.
-Traveling merchants adjusted
-Card effect revisions and tweaks
-Enemy/Friendly changes
-Various difficulty improvements / optimizations

[b]1. Combat Scene Adjustment[/b]
In the current combat scene, with the growing number of characters and statuses, the scene has become very crowded.
Therefore, we have adjusted the size of the characters to make them more proportional to each other and to make the overall look more comfortable.
The UI has also been adjusted to make it cleaner, so that the player only needs to focus on controlling the lower half of the screen.

[b]New[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/530df912d91c30421bc7b4efa1debdd85893fe19.png[/img]

[b]Old[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/9e52539d8e078d0642caf9d082e8a6ee2ccd9b80.jpg[/img]

[b]2. The language used in the previous beginner's tutorials was really unpleasant.[/b]
In this revision, we have added a corresponding narrator to increase the sense of immersion.
As for who is this previous bad-talking narrator?
Please dig into the story mode and discover for yourselves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/23ed0e87df56bdee4f93624cd0adcccda4639da8.png[/img]

[b]3. Griza currently has too little freedom in the way it plays with summons.[/b]
We will adjust the summoning cost of the units to address this issue.
The adjustments are as follows:
Forge of the initial blessing is increased from 2 → 7.
Forge required for Griza's summoning from 1~2 → 2~6
Forge obtained from cards from 1 → 1~3
For Griza's Summons, we've increased the number of adjustments.
We have increased the amount of Forge needed to strengthen the unit.
We have also adjusted the amount of Forge that can be obtained from cards.
In short, we've adjusted the numbers to make Griza's summoning gameplay more flexible.

[b]4. The previous version of Source Nexus was unsatisfactory in many features and interactions.[/b]
One of the main points of this update is the complete reworking of Source Nexus.
The major changes are as follows
The interface for adding Summons to your team is now more comprehensive.
The interface for purchasing Crystal has been redesigned, and instead of purchasing a fixed amount of Crystals, you can obtain Crystals by consuming sources for a limited number.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/ee0af420407000450e01ad8253aaccc8c02401ee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/cf7aab614001e9b04abef837f96a148cbdadab9b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/2819520bf2cd23d74ca324534b79bb100cf1412d.png[/img]

[b]5. The campsite has changed from a simple function selection to a more immersive and interactive interface.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/9c190f7373eefd4fa51f1632e4651b2dfda010b0.png[/img]

[b]6. Players can now select Encyclopedia options in the title to find all cards and enchantments currently available in the Voice of Belldona Demo.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4ccd9c65c5972f274bb769daf614e6dafacdfc96.png[/img]

[b]7. A new mysterious character that appears in the main story mode.[/b]
What is the relationship between this mysterious character and Sheryl?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/143738d7156be6bb71485582265553fee3606b52.png[/img]

[b]8. Adjusted the location of dialog options/card information.[/b]
Instead of appearing in strange places every time, they will now appear in a fixed place.
Also, the conversation option's message will no longer block the name of the character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/bd15a8ac690200608cded82ab47a64490f3a8ee0.png[/img]

[b]9. The Traveling Merchant has been modified as follows[/b]
The price of tips has been changed from 50 to 20
(The original tip was so expensive that no one would want to use it, and it completely lost its meaning.)
NPC's lines and animations have been added to make them more vivid.
[u][b]You can no longer refresh cards by reloading the save.[/b][/u]

[b]10. Adjustments and functionality fixes for cards[/b]
[u]Griza.[/u]

notes.title: Story Mode is online！
notes.content:
The second major update of Voice of Belldona demo is here!

In this update, the "Story Mode" is back online, with the participation of the popular Taiwanese author "Guiltnovel", added stories full of laughs and excitement, and the mysterious reptoids nun (?), who claims to be a once-in-a-millennium beauty, are going to reveal to everyone.


In addition to the new mode, many experience optimizations and game balancing improvements have been made, so let's take a look at the contents of this update.

[list]
[*] New NPCs have been officially unveiled.
[*] Completely remastered story mode.
[*] A complete overhaul of the in game store.
[*] Various gameplay experience optimizations and balances.
[/list]


[h1][b]Nun (?)[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/f8e6fa729f6383952eb790899f36a447db312156.png[/img]

I'm just a once-in-a-century, innocent and seductive forever young lizard girl, Rawr!

A new mysterious NPC - Nun(?).
A strange character who always speaks in a variety of “seductive” words and phrases.
Players will encounter this mysterious NPC, who calls herself "Mysterious Lizard Girl", on their journey.
But she seems to be helping the protagonists intentionally or unintentionally...


[h1][b]Story Mode[/b][/h1]

After choosing to start a new game, players can choose between Story Mode and Challenge Mode to play the game in their favorite way.

In Story Mode, players will be able to experience the full story and plot of Voice of Belldona.

Try your hand at the various options and you may find a variety of unexpected results waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4633e71d5e78e76b0ddcb2e3357060946a09d17c.png[/img]
Let's turn back here, we should try to do less dangerous things, don't you think it's good to live a relaxing life?

[h1][b]Traveling Merchants[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/ccff7b23e62bacae17c75532998886fd1c556619.png[/img]

When you happen to come across a strange store on your journey, go inside and you will see a tiny and adorable robot greeting you, it might be a good choice to trade items with him.


Speaking of which, why is there a store in the middle of the nowhere...?



[h1][b]Balancing and Changes[/b][/h1]

Players will now be alerted to the end of each map's story, with an additional icon reminding them to prepare for the end of each chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/0436cf443a787596aece9847fecce7a8302b7308.png[/img]

Lots of players have complained that they are entering boss fights all of a sudden, but now they can prepare for them in advance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/f7c642b26b007eb26e59265995b166e40919e210.png[/img]

Players can now hover over side quest’s options to see exactly what they are rewarded for.

[h1][b]Rinna's Sanity System[/b][/h1]
Changed from "Every time a combo was used, +3 Sanity " to "Every time a combo was used, +2 Sanity, +4 Sanity per combo derivative".
Since the Sanity of a Combo Build is still continuing to decrease during a fight, we've adjusted Rina's ways of obtaining Sanity.
We've increased the number of methods to gain Sanity, so that Combo Builds can accumulate Sanity faster while using combo derivation.
At the same time, we have slightly lowered the effect of the normal Sanity boost when acquiring finishing moves and increase the flexibility of Carnage Builds in terms of Sanity.

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
-Bleed and burn debuff now trigger normally.
- "Choose 1 ally: Lose HP" is now no longer affected by player’s strength or the chosen ally's reflect/counter.
(Griza will now finally not die from Killian's counter)
-Rina's Bloodforged Weapon will now display its effects properly in battle.
(A lot of people thought the Bloodforged weapons were all useless, but now players will know their effects properly.)
-Fixed the dialog display anomaly in Cheryl scenes.
-Fixed resolution switch icon display error.
-Fixed Rinna's preset deck text error.
-Fixed a bug in the buff icon when Emily spawns.
-Fixed the bug that the "Continue Game" option would appear even after finish the demo.
-Fixed a bug where the game might freeze at the end of the round.
(Please let us know if there are any more similar cases.)


[h1][b]Other Adjustments[/b][/h1]
-Adjusted the action icon
-Fixed Chery;'s English text
-The information of allay cards in battle now will only show card art.
-Block is now shown on the right side of the HP.

That's all for this update, if there is anything you would like to let us know, please feel free to do so through the questionnaire or by joining the community!

notes.title: 0.3.1 DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
We've received a lot of great feedback since the release of the overhaul.

Let's take a look at the changes we've made to the current version ahead of the Steam New Game Festival and the 10th of Oct holiday!

[list]
[*] [h1]Fixes, QoL and Optimizations[/h1]

Bug fixes for the bald traveler's quest script and the inability to get the quest finish reward.
(Now he'll “hand” out the stuff properly.)

Card "Desire" generated by casting finisher "Desperate Desire" will now properly add to the draw pile as described, instead of straight to the hand.

Now, card "Hunt" will also trigger additional damage bonus to units effected by "Target Revealed."

Fixed the bald traveler's event where the battle could not be fought properly.
(One of the main reasons why Rinna's two Legendary Cards could not be obtained.)

Corrected the position of the black outline in map tutorial.

Combo cards generated by Rinna's Blood-Red Weapon will now display a combo prompt.

Rinna's Finisher button now displays effects.

Card "Valkyrie's Vals” now correctly triggers the elimination effect.

Fixed the problem that the card "Desire" sometimes got stuck on the right side of the screen.

Combo cards now have icons, so you can visualize the effect of a combo.

Renovation and revision of the English translation.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h1]Game Balance[/h1]

[h3]Rinna's sanity system upper and lower limits have changed to +-90.[/h3]
(Increasing the upper and lower limits of sanity not only makes it easier for the player to reach the upper and lower limits of sanity in one battle, but also increases the player's room for maneuver, such as no longer make your time maintaining low sanity at 3rd stage go to waste just because you used a finisher once.)

[h3]Rinna's sanity system changes +-15, +-45, +-75 in each of the three stages.[/h3]
Rinna's Sanity System's Low Sanity 2nd level effect is now no longer has “Deadly”.
(Deadly's effect is so powerful that we've redefined it as a powerful finishing move, and if it's a permanent effect, Rinna is able to easily resolve all enemies with basically no draws)

[h3]Finisher "Seal"[/h3]
Removed “Void” Effect
(Now you can keep it in your hand and play it when you need it.)

[h3]Finishing move "Demonic Majesty”[/h3]
The additional deadly(5) of "Carnage" effect becomes deadly(1).

[h3]Card "Eruption of Rage”S[/h3]
Added “Elimination” Effect

[h3]Card " Slaughter Aura "[/h3]
Reduces the number of "Deadly” stacks gained

[h3]Card "Ymir's Avatar: Assimilation".[/h3]
Sanity Requirement changed to -75

[h3]Card "Valkyrie's Vals”[/h3]
Sanity requirement changes to +75

[h3]-Reduces the amount of supplies you get after winning a battle.[/h3]
(It's a bit too much to be able to wander through the whole map and become Financial independence.)
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Voice of Belldona has received its first HUGE update for the demo version![/b][/h1]

In this update, the cute and dangerous new character "Rinna" is officially added, with more than a hundred new cards, new blessing, tutorial, a completely revamped interface, new character interaction scenes, and various balancing and changes. With all that said, let's take a look at what has been brought to the game.

[list]
[*] [h3]A new character, Rinna, with superior sword skills and the power of wrath.[/h3]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Challenge Mode that allows players to focus on intense and challenging battles and exploration during the gameplay.[/h3]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Revamped Interface[/h3]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Interact with Cheryl, a mysterious loli. Find out what she's up to before you start writing new battles.[/h3]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Various balancing changes have been made to make the gameplay experience more comfortable and fun.[/h3]
[/list]


[list]
[*] [b][h1]Rinsana.I.Minter.Yorkwem
[/h1][/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/b0a493abf1db5d188096316db24dec5a48a65f8e.png[/img]
Finally, it's my chance to rise and shine. Let's see what I'm capable of.ːsteamhappyː

[b]A girl who is always as bright and optimistic as the sun, no matter what adversity she faces.
Sometimes she is so optimistic that it feels so strange ....
When in an argument, she will use her "fists" to reason with the other.

In addition to his martial arts skills, which she has acquired through years of training, she has an ability that she rarely uses in front of others.
An ability rarely used in front of the casuals under her adoptive father's tutelage - the "Carnage".
Which makes the deadliest existence on the battlefield.[/b]

Unlike Griza, who always needs the help of others to win fights, the heroine "Rinna", who temporarily becomes the property of the hero "Griza" in this game, has a tremendous capability of solo combat.

As she combines the most devastating finishing moves with her blade waltz, the brutal violence in her bloodline also awakens, allowing her to gain even more power and summon a variety of blood creatures and weapons.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]100+ New Cards[/h2]
Rinna's cards have no armor acquisition, or ability to strengthen units other than her own.

Instead, they have a fighting style that allows for flashy combos, various damage reduction, and the ability to inflict massive amounts of bleeding damage on the enemy while recovering from your own wounds as you bathe in the enemy's blood.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Combo / Finisher[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/ac87ecab5a04c2b708880562cd66ab606078d7df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/e468d64fb66e5c96a4f3591c75f2c6245732198d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/1dd825c924e8dd675934557779dcc9b5e18c739d.png[/img]
Tutored by her father, the proverbial "Behemoth Slaughterer", Rinna not only has exceptional strength and techniques, but all of her attack moves have additional combo effects.

When a card with a combo effect is played, an additional combo indicator appears above the character, and if the next sequence of combos is followed, an additional "Finisher" can be activated.

Finishers are not only a powerful way to annihilate your enemies, but also a great way to turn the tide of battle if you combine them appropriately according to the current battle scenario.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Carnage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/05d243f33a8a47eb7c2882c8e3649e78e075035e.png[/img]
As Rinna bathes in the blood of her enemies and herself on the battlefield, the dangerous force hidden in her bloodstream is gradually being unleashed.

When Rinna engages an enemy or when she herself is attacked by an enemy, the energy known as "Carnage" builds up.

Some cards are able to utilize "Carnage" to channel additional power, and even shape ominous crimson weapons and creatures.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Sanity value[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/fbcb412a4878983302089eccd753a3b616229667.jpg[/img]
Whether it's decimating a victim with a barrage of eye-catching combos.

Or uncontrollably release the amount of brutal violence hidden inside her, will be swayed by Rinna's sanity.

And with the change of sanity, the style of fighting will also alter... It's up to you to decide which fighting style you want to adopt.
[/list]


[b][h1]All new playmode![/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/14c835ec8b01236b1d3f426c6d6a4c7a0d6b7b8e.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]
After choosing to start a new game, players are free to choose between Story Mode and Challenge Mode to play the game the way they like.

In Challenge Mode, most of the storyline will be skipped and dialog will be greatly condensed, allowing players to focus on fighting and exploring in Challenge Mode.

Additional difficulty levels are scheduled to be added in future releases.

[u][b]*Story Mode is currently closed in order to reorganize the content to give players a more complete gameplay experience.[/b][/u]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Tutorial/Guidance[/h2]
Players can now select the Tutorial/Guidance Mode in the title, so players who don't understand the gameplay or character mechanics can always learn about them in the Tutorial/Guidance.
[/list]

[h1][b]New Interfaces[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [h2]Game Start[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/7eaf2a1e357048225459b58f151580b7162012ba.jpg[/img]
At the start of the game, players can now choose their character and start with a default deck.

This allows players to see the style and composition of the deck more clearly.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Loading Screen[/h2]
Reillustration of transitions and graphics of the loading screen.

Loading screens are now randomized to display a variety of in-game artwork during transitions, instead of just a simple black screen.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Character Information[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4f24334c3f803b709e6cea8f2c3cd054c3f8647b.jpg[/img]
The bottom right corner of the screen now shows you how much "Crystal" you have left to use to enhance your troops, and an additional indicator has been added.

By clicking on the bookmark on the book, the player can view all the character information and switch between the following at any time.

Main Character Status
Deck
Blessings
Friendlies
Moves (Rinna Only)
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Map[/h2]
The re-drawn map scene makes players feel like they are actually in front of a map.

In addition to using the button to switch viewpoints, there is also a new function to directly switch viewpoints by the left & right click.
[/list]

[h1][b]Let's play with Cheryl[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/05700338169d33c898bfd802f7967bae9b8a00a7.jpg[/img]
In the preparation area, there is a shy and introverted girl staying in a cabin.
The real identity of this girl, Cheryl, is still unknown.
But why don't you stop by and say hello to her?
It may have a significant impact on the plot in the near future.


[b][h1]Balance Changes[/h1][/b]

Along with the new characters, we've also made changes to some existing content.

[list]
[*] [b]Alliance Swordsman[/b]
As one of the most frequently seen enemy in the game, many people think of him as a counter-attacking bastard who always stays in the front line and doesn't engage with the player, so we've revamped his skills and stats without modifying his basic mechanics.

Now the Alliance Swordsman will no longer have counters and his initial skill strength has been reduced, but as the rounds progress, he will gradually grow into a fearsome fighter and tank.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Griza [/b]
So far for this jack-of-all-trades versatile character, we've made adjustments to some of his cards, so let's take a look at the ones that have been tweaked.

[list]
[*] Overnight
Gain Weakness (1). Draw a card (2).
↓
Gain Weakness (1). Burn (1). Draw a card (2).

Being a 0-cost draw 2, we don't intend to nerf his card draw ability but rather increase the risk of using him nearly as much.
[/list]

[list]
[*] layout
Cannot be played. Eliminate :『Gain 2 Energy』.
↓
Cannot be played. Discard : 『Gain 2 Energy』.

We've repositioned the Eliminate from Hand ability as Rinna's personal trait. Then made this card useful in more situations.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Flustered
Cannot be played. Discard from hand: 『Draw a card (2)』.
Cost : 0
↓
Draw a card (2). Discard from hand: 『Draw a card (2)』.
Cost : 2

We have increased the flexibility of this card so that players can now discard cards in addition to other cards to activate the effect.
This allows this card to be used in more situations.
[/list]
[/list]

There are also a lot of details and updates that have not been introduced here, so if you're interested in the new character "Rinna" or the shy and introverted little girl "Cheryl", Try out the demo! Feel free to comment and let us know what you think.

notes.title: 0.21試玩版內容更新
notes.content:
[b]嗨，大家辛苦了，今天又是令人期待的周末，讓我們來看看經過一個禮拜的《紡織者之詠試玩版》作了些什麼改動[/b]

[h1][b]．新手教學[/b][/h1]
先讓我們來看看，為什麼是新手教學？
很簡單，因為很多人都跟我們反應不知道遊戲的機制，甚至在不知道升級跟覺醒的情況下遊玩，因此我們大刀闊斧的翻新了整個新手教學
-優化新手教學，讓玩家知道踩『？』會發生什麼事
-優化新手教學，引導玩家升級/強化迴音逝從
-優化新手教學，引導玩家『燈塔』的作用
-優化新手教學，引導玩家知道在地圖進行地區切換時會進行物資消耗
-優化新手教學，引導玩家使其更清楚的知道什麼是每個角色的特殊機制(如格雷薩的『覺醒』)
-修正新手教學部分圖標顯示不完整的問題
-優化了新手教學的文案，使其更容易閱讀，不再一次顯示過多內容


[h1][b]-標題畫面新增了「從頭開始」的選項[/b][/h1]

有不少對劇情感興趣的玩家，對於沒辦法體驗到開頭的劇情感到可惜，我們因此新增「從頭開始」讓對劇情感興趣的玩家能更輕鬆地體驗內容。


[h1][b]．遊戲優化[/b][/h1]

除了新手教學外，還有惱人的卡頓優化已經正在進行中
-優化了戰鬥的讀取
-優化了對話的讀取
目前的優化尚不完整(不如說優化本就是一條無盡的道路)，但奶茶(我們的工程師大大)已經就一些已知的點開始優化，不妨告訴我們是否有所改善。

[b]．錯誤修正[/b]
除了新手教學和優化外，我們來看看還修正/新增了些什麼吧
-修正了地圖移動消耗提示顯示不正確
-修正了完成支線後會完成主線的問題(嘿對，就是你光頭商人)
-修正了戰鬥勝利石頭獎勵不正確的問題
-修正了卡片「幸運」使用多次後會有無法抽牌的問題
-修正了當卡片效果需要選擇牌堆時排版問題以及確認按鈕位置詭異的問題
-修正了卡片「洗牌」會有影分身(牌堆/棄牌堆各有一張)的問題
-修正了戰鬥中回到標題再重新戰鬥，戰鬥結束之後迴到大地圖鏡頭有可能會有位置錯誤的問題。
-修正了商店小費的費用累積不正確(正常來說就是它其實是要慢慢變貴的)
-修正了營地的消除卡片時牌組顯示不正確的問題
-修正了覺醒費用在戰鬥開始時有可能消失(雖然重新讀取就會恢復正常，但仍然是個惱人的問題)
-修正了部分卡片的類型
-修正了詐欺師初始覺醒是『戰鬥』而非『巧計』的問題(預設牌組不變)

當然除了優化和修正還有很多令人期待的內容我們也在加緊製作中，未來都會慢慢與大家見面
-修女(?)的角色立繪
-新的可玩角色
-新的支線


[h1][b]祝各位有個愉快的周末 [/b][/h1]

notes.title: 【紡織者之詠】早期測試版現已開放試玩
notes.content:
[h2][h1][b]我們很高興的向各位宣布，我們的試玩版現已上架，歡迎各位來進行測試遊玩[/b][/h1][/h2]

經過團隊的不懈努力，我們很榮幸的向各位呈上紡織者之詠的早期試玩版。
由於遊戲尚處於早期試玩版，因此遊戲內容還有許多不夠完善之處，還望各位玩家們海涵。

試玩版須知

1.當前遊戲尚未完成優化，第一次進入戰鬥的讀取時間會花些許時間，希望大家能在第一次讀取戰鬥時耐心等候，我們會加緊改善這個問題。

2.卡圖目前尚未全部完成，因此試玩版的卡圖將以【典藏版】卡圖代替。

3.試玩版提供的遊玩內容為遊戲的【第一章的部分內容】與【男主角】，我們正在加緊腳步製作女主角的部分，屆時也會開放給玩家進行試玩，敬請期待。

4.為了確保試玩版的遊戲體驗，我們對遊戲內可獲得的資源和卡片效果等做了相應調整，數值不一定會與正式版完全相同。

5.試玩版不限時，目前也沒有打算未來會下架，我們會持續進行除錯與試玩的內容更新。

6.由於遊戲當前為早期試玩版本，您有可能在遊戲中碰到些許我們預期外的錯誤，這些錯誤可能會出現令人捧腹大笑的娛樂效果，但也有可能出現導致整個遊戲崩潰閃退的錯誤，若在進行遊玩時出現了這樣的錯誤，我們深感歉意，同時還希望您可以向我們回報您的錯誤情況，幫助我們的遊戲可以變得更好。

感謝您遊玩紡織者之詠的早期試玩版
